title: portfolio_construction.v1
description: Evidence that `crucible.portfolio` constructed the book a grade was taken over, and the cost model that priced it. Rides on the grading run's manifest as a MetricRecord payload; a phase-3 clause reads it there. Self-describing on purpose: it carries the full parameter set INLINE beside the digest, so a reader whose digest no longer resolves still has every value the book was built on.

trading_day.description: NYSE trading day the construction is keyed to.

engine.description: The module that built the book. A constant rather than free text: this field is what a gate clause matches on, and a field that could say anything can say nothing.

cost_model.description: The model IN FORCE, by name and by every parameter it read. Recorded on every run that applies costs, so a grade can never be read without knowing what it was charged, and a stand-in can never be mistaken for the configured model.

placeholder.description: True when the model is a declared stand-in. Required rather than inferred from the name: a verdict graded against a stand-in must say so on its face.

params.description: The portfolio parameter set the book was constructed under, in full. Values are strategy edge and originate in the private strategy tree; they are recorded HERE because a verdict whose construction parameters are only referenced is not reproducible once the reference moves.

params_digest.description: Digest over `params`. A cheap equality test across runs — never the only copy of the values, so a digest whose source has been retuned strands no reader.

components.description: The four named components, each recorded as applied or not WITH A REASON. A component absent from an artifact is indistinguishable from one that never ran; all four are always present.

sessions.description: Trading sessions the book spans. Zero is not expressible: a construction over no session produced no evidence and must not be recorded as though it had.

reason.description: Why the component is in the state it is. Null only when applied is true and the reason is simply that it was configured on.
